titleAnalysis.reasoning: Core medical roles like Pathologist tend to have reasonably standardized titles across hospitals and diagnostic chains, but variations appear due to subspecialties (Molecular Pathology, Hematopathology), seniority tags (Consultant, Senior Consultant), and institutional hierarchy (Attending, Specialist).
titleAnalysis.recommendation: Use job title expansion with functional keywords (Pathology, Molecular Pathology, Diagnostic Pathology) since core title is stable but subspecialty variations are common.
